title: Use Conservation of Momentum
text: Derive an equation with only $$v_{1,\text{f}}$$ and $$v_{2,\text{f}}$$ from $$p_{\text{initial}}=p_{\text{final}}.$$ Here, $$p_{\text{initial}}=0$$ and $$p_{\text{final}}=m_{1}v_{1,\text{f}}+m_{2}v_{2,\text{f}}$$.

title: Use Conservation of Energy
text: Derive an equation with only $$v_{1,\text{f}}$$ and $$v_{2,\text{f}}$$ from $$KE=\tfrac12m_{1}v_{1,\text{f}}**2+\tfrac12m_{2}v_{2,\text{f}}**2,$$ where $$KE=5000\, \text{J}$$.

title: Solve for $$v_{1,\text{f}}$$
text: Combine the two equations into $$5000=2400v_{1,\text{f}}**2+750\left(\tfrac{4800}{1500}\right)**2v_{1,\text{f}}**2$$ and solve for $$v_{1,\text{f}}$$.
